meta.description: Daily loan snapshot with the penalty accrued so far.
meta.sql:
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE spark_catalog.demo_dwd.dwd_lending_loan_df PARTITION (dt = '${bizdate}')
SELECT l.loan_no,
       l.cust_no AS customer_id,
       l.principal AS principal_amt,
       l.loan_status,
       COALESCE(p.penalty_amt, 0) AS penalty_amt
FROM demo_ods.ods_loan_contract_df l
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT loan_no, SUM(penalty) AS penalty_amt
    FROM demo_ods.ods_loan_penalty_di
    WHERE dt <= '${bizdate}'
    GROUP BY loan_no
) p ON l.loan_no = p.loan_no
WHERE l.dt = '${bizdate}'
